# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: You heard what $$ユダ$$ said earlier too, did you not?!
The true nature of this $$大邪神$$ armor is...
a cursed $$生きた鎧$$ that seals the souls of the $$邪神$$s who bore white $$羽$$ and perished in the $$創世記戦争$$!
If an ordinary person wears it...
they cannot take it off—not until they die and their corpse is devoured by the armor,
and it will keep drinking their $$生き血$$ without cease...
Even this $$ルピルピ$$, now a $$邪道騎士$$... is a pitiful victim of such armor.
Apparently, to wear this armor without being devoured by it,
a special aptitude... is required.
When I realized that... I understood the feelings of the girl who had been worried for my health...
and I meant to die in prison, just as I was...!
M-$$お師匠様$$!
But by good fortune, I met you!!
That light you cast in the prison...
was undeniably the evil sign heralding the return of $$大悪神ゴッド$$!
Perhaps you can wear this armor of $$メタトロン$$...
Perhaps you can even wear it!!
I am sorry I tried to use you as a test subject for this armor without telling you.
I will not force you. But if you truly wish to rescue your $$飼い主$$...
there is no other way now than to gain the power of the $$大邪神$$ within this armor!!
But...
to put this armor on, you must tear off your own $$羽$$ with your own hands...
You have to tear them off yourself!
Do you have the resolve... to do that?!
